ranked_facts.concept_key: Past medical history of similar episodes
ranked_facts.why: The patient's history of two prior similar episodes over eight years cannot be easily explained by an infectious or inflammatory process, but it is consistent with a neoplastic process such as a Keratocystic Odontogenic Tumor.

ranked_facts.concept_key: Imaging findings of a well-defined soft-tissue mass with cystic areas
ranked_facts.why: The imaging findings of a well-defined soft-tissue mass with cystic areas are more consistent with a neoplastic process such as a Keratocystic Odontogenic Tumor than with an infectious or inflammatory process.
